label: late-episode ramp; GO lower after a1 / S1-belief / reward; D2 higher in S1
terms: (phase == GO) * table(prev_action, {1: 1, 2: -1}) * np.exp(ep_trial / 15.0) ;; (phase == GO) * np.clip(belief_lo, -4, 4) * np.exp(ep_trial / 15.0) ;; (phase == D2) * table(state, {1: 1, 2: -1}) * np.exp(ep_trial / 15.0) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 1) * np.exp(ep_trial / 15.0) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 1) * table(prev_action, {1: 1, 2: -1}) * np.exp(ep_trial / 15.0) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 1) * np.exp(ep_trial / 15.0)
explanation: Raw candidate n of unit 14 sits near -1 for most of the episode and ramps strongly toward + in the last ~20 trials (timing alone R^2 0.88). All history effects are small early and grow with that ramp, so each term is scaled by exp(ep_trial/15); unscaled versions score only 0.10 dev vs 0.26 scaled. At GO it is lower after choosing a1 (higher after a2), lower when the ideal-observer belief favours S1 (belief_lo), and lower after a reward (with an extra drop after rewarded a1), i.e. it is higher when the observed history points to a2/S2 or the last trial went unrewarded. At D2 it is higher when S1 is reached and lower for S2. At D1 it is higher after a rewarded trial. Only observed quantities used (no value/policy/model_act, no future). Test R^2 beyond timing 0.248 (dev 0.273), above the profile additive all ceiling 0.21 and all-observed 0.17 because of the time scaling. Residual misses are large whole-window offsets late in the episode (episode-level drift not captured by history) and leftover GO-after-unrewarded under-prediction; adding the trial-before reward, a D1 belief x last-state term or a within-decile time ramp added <0.015 dev. Replacing the model value/policy with belief loses little: the policy decile reference alone was 0.08 vs belief decile 0.06.
